name: Mettlach (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided light blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Mettlach (three white roses on light blue).
history: Municipal flag of Mettlach; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Mettlach arms — three white roses on light blue
